name: Cup of Tea
desc: Hot, sweet and strangely effective. Restores 20 HP.

name: Flask of Tea
desc: Somebody's gran packed this. Restores 60 HP and a sense of calm.

name: Bakewell Tart
desc: It's a tart, not a pudding. Restores 10 PP to every move.

name: Buxton Water
desc: Filtered through miles of limestone. Cures every status.

name: Smelling Salts
desc: One sniff and you're wide awake and fully aware of your surroundings.

name: Kendal Mint Cake
desc: Fuel for fell walkers. Revives a fainted creature at half HP.

name: Bara Brith
desc: Tea-soaked fruit loaf, butter optional, opinions compulsory. Restores 60 HP.

name: Scouse
desc: Lamb stew, bread and a healthy dose of Liverpool attitude. Restores 80 HP.

name: Eccles Cake
desc: Flaky pastry, currants and a bit of Lancashire smugness. Cures chills, muddles, stings and sleep.

name: Soda Bread
desc: No yeast, no fuss, and a cross cut in the top to let the fairies out. Restores 70 HP.

name: Barmbrack
desc: Fruit loaf with a ring hidden inside. Whoever finds the ring gets a year of luck. Restores 120 HP.

name: Pasty
desc: Crimped on the side, never on the top, and only ever eaten on a windy cliff. Restores 100 HP.

name: Cream Tea
desc: Scone, jam, clotted cream and a fierce argument about whether the jam goes on first. Restores all HP.

name: Tablet
desc: A crumbly Scottish bar of sugar, butter and condensed milk, so sweet your teeth will want a word. Restores 90 HP.

name: Cranachan
desc: Cream, oats, honey, raspberries and a good splash of whisky, layered in a glass and worth the trip north. Restores 150 HP.

name: Soda Farl
desc: A quarter of soda bread griddled flat, the only correct way to eat it according to every Ulster grandmother. Restores 75 HP.

name: Ulster Fry
desc: Rashers, sausage, egg, soda farl and a potato bread nobody has the heart to refuse. Restores all HP, and you will need a lie down after.

name: Irn Tonic
desc: A fizzy tonic of questionable origin that cures every status and would like you to know it has had a good year.

name: Yorkshire Pudding
desc: Batter, hot fat and a tin that should have been hotter. Restores 130 HP. Gravy is not included, and you will have to argue for it.

name: Parkin
desc: Sticky ginger cake made with oats and treacle, for Bonfire Night, best eaten a few days after baking. Restores 110 HP. Keeps for a week, which is more restraint than it deserves.

name: Pork Pie
desc: Hot water crust, a jelly nobody asked about and a pastry you could use as a doorstop. Restores 140 HP. Melton Mowbray has never once stopped arguing about the jelly.
